t: This is Church House, headquarters of the Church of England, at the south end of Dean's Yard beside Westminster Abbey. It holds offices for the Church Commissioners and the Archbishops' Council, and a chamber for the General Synod. During the Second World War it served as a meeting place for Parliament, and afterwards it hosted the first meeting of the United Nations Security Council. The architect Sir Herbert Baker designed it. He was the most prominent and prolific English architect of his generation, and is remembered for his Neo-Classical work in South Africa.
